items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. It is the only training with a hard deadline shorter than 30 days, because system access is granted on day one and the risk starts with it.

The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. Enrolling early means the elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. An employee has 30 days from the end of the waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock.

Recommendation — not company policy: Complete benefits elections during week one so they are in place when your 90-day waiting period ends and coverage becomes eligible. Attend a People Operations benefits question session (held every second Tuesday) if you need clarification on plan options.

Next steps:
- Complete security and acceptable-use training within 14 days of start date
- Complete all four required trainings (security, data protection, anti-harassment, anti-bribery) by day 30
- Enrol in 401(k) and make benefits elections in week one
- Verify device setup (laptop, peripherals) is complete before day one

You meet the tenure requirement: employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country. Your tenure as of 2026-09-01 is 45 months.

Your proposed stay of 42 consecutive days (3 November to 14 December, inclusive) exceeds the 30-day threshold and therefore requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins, director approval (not just manager approval), and written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your 42-day stay falls within the rolling 90-day annual limit for work outside your home country.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. You must notify IT Security of the destination at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules can be adjusted.

Recommendation — not company policy: Tax & Legal review typically approves stays over 30 days with conditions, most often a prohibition on customer-facing activity and a hard end date. Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with exact dates and workspace address at least 21 calendar days before 3 November.

Escalation: File your Tax & Legal review request and obtain director approval through People Operations at mobility@mosaicrobotics.example to confirm all three approvals (manager, director, Tax & Legal) are in place before departure.

Next steps:
- Raise manager approval request in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days before 3 November with destination, exact dates, and workspace address.
- File Tax & Legal review request at least 21 calendar days before departure.
- Obtain director approval (required for stays exceeding 30 consecutive days).
- Confirm with IT Security that your travel laptop is company-managed, encrypted, and on always-on VPN, and notify them of Germany at least 5 business days before departure.

Recommendation — not company policy: I need one more detail before I can answer. Clarification needed: 'time off' is ambiguous. Specify type (PTO, sick leave, unpaid, sabbatical) and dates/duration to proceed. Employee ids look like E1042, and dates are clearest as an explicit day and month.

Next steps:
- Reply with the missing detail and I will pick this up.

Recommendation — not company policy: I cannot answer that: the question is not about Mosaic Robotics HR policy or your own HR data. I answer only from the Mosaic Robotics policy corpus and your own HR data, and I do not answer from general knowledge. I can also look up your own HR data with 9 tools.

Next steps:
- The corpus covers: Benefits and Open Enrollment Guide; Equipment & Asset Policy; Expenses & Reimbursement Policy; HR Escalation & Case Handling Policy; Leave of Absence Policy; Manager Approval Matrix; Onboarding & First 90 Days; Performance & Compensation Policy; PTO & Holidays Policy; Remote & Hybrid Work Policy; Security & Acceptable Use Policy; Tax & Location Addendum; Travel Policy; Workplace Conduct Policy.
- Ask about one of those policies, or contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example.

Escalation: This is a matter for a person, not for an automated assistant. Mosaic Robotics policy routes harassment, discrimination, retaliation, legal threats, medical matters and pay disputes to a named People Operations partner, so I will not answer it here. Contact employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example, or raise a case in MosaicOne under "Raise an HR case". You may also use the third-party ethics line anonymously.

Next steps:
- Email employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example — a case needs only your name and a description of the matter.
- Or raise it yourself in MosaicOne under "Raise an HR case"; you will get a case reference.
- If you would like me to open an HR case for you, say so and I will show you the exact summary for your confirmation before anything is created.
Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's specific onsite days with your manager

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

Retirement plan eligibility is different and shorter: an employee may begin contributing to the 401(k) plan from their first payroll run, with no waiting period at all.

Next steps:
- If you have questions about your specific eligibility date, contact People Operations at benefits@mosaicrobotics.example
